original_ai_output.title_zh: 从ShattaFest到MoMo Fest：娱乐在青年互动中占据中心舞台
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 文章指出，娱乐在品牌、艺人和组织与加纳不断增长的青年群体建立联系方面正发挥越来越重要的作用。ShattaFest和MoMo Fest的经验表明，大型娱乐活动能够吸引年轻受众，并创造互动与商业活动的平台。ShattaFest借助Shatta Wale的强大粉丝基础将歌迷聚集在一起。

key_facts.fact: 娱乐在品牌、艺人和组织与加纳青年群体互动中作用日益重要
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Entertainment is playing an increasingly important role in how brands, artistes and organisations connect with Ghana’s growing youth population.

key_facts.fact: ShattaFest和MoMo Fest等大型娱乐活动能够吸引年轻受众并创造互动与商业平台
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Recent experiences from ShattaFest and MoMo Fest have demonstrated how large entertainment programmes can attract young audiences while creating platforms for engagement and commercial activity.

key_facts.fact: ShattaFest借助Shatta Wale的强大粉丝基础聚集歌迷
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: ShattaFest has leveraged Shatta Wale’s strong following to bring fans together
